reports.title: Woodward Reports Record Sales & Earnings for Fiscal Year 2026

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2027 Guidance
section: Our fiscal 2027 guidance assumes a sustained strong demand environment, which will drive continued sales growth and margin expansion. As reflected in our guidance, margin rate expansion will moderate in fiscal 2027 due to higher investments in our manufacturing capabilities and capacity to ensure we can continue to increase production volumes, improve our structural cost position, and deliver durable earnings growth.
